intro-1.text: When a customer clicks a CLICK-zenn button in your email, what do they see next?

intro-2.text: A landing page. In the next few minutes, we'll make it look and sound like your brand, with no web design needed.

why-1.text: Clicking any link in an email opens a web browser, and CLICK-zenn buttons are no different. That visit is what tells CLICK-zenn to update the ticket.

why-2.text: The landing page is what your customer sees next: clear confirmation that their click worked, instead of a blank tab or an error.

why-3.text: CLICK-zenn hosts it for you, and it reads clearly on phones and desktops alike. There's nothing to build or host yourself.

open-1.text: To make it yours, open CLICK-zenn in Zendesk, and click Default Landing Page in the left-hand menu.

open-2.text: There are two pages here, a Confirmation page and a Ticket Closed page, and one set of global settings that styles them both.

brand-1.text: Start with the Global Landing Page Settings. The HTML Browser Title is the text in the browser tab, usually your company name.

brand-2.text: Next, the Template Colors. The Brand Color draws the bold outlines, so it's usually the darker of your colors.

brand-3.text: The Accent Color sits behind the text, and the Text Color is the text itself. Choose a pair that's easy to read.

brand-4.text: Then the Page Header Image, usually your logo. Click Select new image, and choose a JPG, GIF or PNG up to 3 megabytes.

confirm-1.text: Now the Confirmation page. It's shown while the ticket is still active, to let your customer know their response went through.

confirm-2.text: Type your message on the left using simple markdown, and the preview on the right shows how it will look.

confirm-3.text: The toolbar adds common formatting for you, such as bold text or a bulleted list.

confirm-4.text: For security, active content like HTML, JavaScript and CSS is never rendered, so the page stays safe for every customer.

closed-1.text: The Ticket Closed page appears when the ticket is no longer active, for example when it's already been solved and closed.

closed-2.text: It lets your customer know their click can't change anything now, so a helpful next step here goes a long way.

save-1.text: The Preview this page button stays greyed out until your changes are saved. So click Update, at the bottom of the page.

save-2.text: Now click Preview this page, and see the finished page exactly as your customers will.

result-1.text: So when your customer clicks a button in your email,

result-2.text: they land on a page with your logo, your colors and your words, in a browser tab with your company's name.

result-3.text: And if they click a button on a ticket that's already closed, your Ticket Closed page tells them what to do next.

outro-1.text: That's landing pages: a clear, friendly answer to every click, in your own brand, with nothing to host.

outro-2.text: Want to go further? Use your own subdomain, or send customers to a page of your own, such as a help article or a survey, for every button or just one.

outro-3.text: Find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace, and make every click feel like part of your brand.
